# Pin

> Pin is a small statically typed language with PHP 8 syntax, compiled to native code through LLVM, with
> compile-time ownership instead of a garbage collector. It is meant to be written by AI coding agents.
> Version 0.1 (preview). Not everything from PHP exists: read the AI guide before writing Pin.

- [AI guide](docs/ai-guide.md): the complete v0.1 language on one page — rules, idioms, PHP → Pin table, error → fix table
- [Language guide](docs/language.md): the same language explained for people
- [Examples](examples/): runnable programs, including a JSON HTTP API
- Tooling: `pin check --json FILE.pn` (one JSON error per line), `pin run FILE.pn`, `pin build FILE.pn -o OUT`
